projects.name: VolunteerPress
projects.summary: An open-source platform for in-person, local contribution — connecting people who want to serve with organizations doing the work. VolunteerPress grew directly out of CIT Serve sessions: serving alongside local organizations, listening to the challenges they face, and building toward technical solutions.
